failure_summary.description: The answer named a related topic or property instead of the requested referent, or failed to satisfy the complete clue despite existing slot and evidence checks.
The response was relevant but mismatched the expected lexical granularity, including unnecessary name parts or detail.
The partial-name guidance favored returning only the blank component when the expected answer was the complete conventional name.
A bare list of people was treated as a family relation rather than prompting the shared contextual value.

patch.reasoning: Most referent and clue-reading errors are already covered by the skill's answer-slot and complete-clue checks, so adding more general wording would duplicate existing guidance. Clarify the one misleading completion rule: a blank may request only a token, or the full conventional name formed by the blank and supplied text.

edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, identify the requested answer unit before responding. If the prompt clearly asks for a missing component, return only that component; if it asks for a conventional full name or expression whose parts are split between a blank and supplied text, return the complete name or expression. Do not mechanically omit supplied components or mechanically repeat them.
